title: JTMM (Just too many mods)
description: this mod will add far too many things into minecraft, anything I could think of and my take on other mods too.
body:
Welcome to JTMM by Berserker Studios.
This mods adds from ores to dimentions to mobs to items and more, if I could think it up, it is here.
(one of the mods that was recreated here was my mod on another website called BerserkTools)
at the moment, there isn't as much as there should be but you have to start somewhere, right?
If you install this expecting there to be a shift in default gameplay textures or features at the start, think again because I can't code so I just used Mcreator's default features and way too many tutorials.

Road Map:
Wood tools change based off what wood you use (in progress)
Deepslate tools (in progress)
Redstone farm craftable guide book (est release, 1 week after deepslate tools)

(the current Alpha that is available has very little in it with all of the tools but they are not all finished so youmight want to wait for the next alpha when they are done but if you do install the first edition, be prepared that it may be not usefull for a bit until I can finish the first 3 things on the roadmap)
